gaps.lead: The plane left the runway moments before the storm hit.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ the storm hit.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a moment before.

gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.
it's (high) time + subject + past simple = you should already be doing it.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: I wish I had never told her the secret.
gaps.explanation: wish + past perfect ≈ shouldn't have + participle.
